name: code-simplifier
title_zh: 删掉多余分配和绕路写法的 Rust 代码审阅员
tagline_zh: 它专挑你代码里的过度设计：不必要的堆分配、绕了三层的迭代器、能写成 match 却写成一串 if。改完行为不变。
tagline_en: It hunts over-engineering: needless allocs, convoluted iterators, if-chains that should be match. Behavior.
desc_en: Review RTK Rust code for idiomatic simplification. Detects over-engineering, unnecessary allocations, verbose patterns. Applies Rust idioms without changing behavior.
why_zh: 不是风格建议，是机制级简化：它认得 Rust 惯用法的等价变换，只动结构不动语义。
why_en: Not style tips—mechanical simplifications. It knows idiomatic equivalences, rewrites structure without touching semantics, like.
limit_zh: 只审 RTK 仓库里的 Rust 代码，且只做简化不改行为；不查安全漏洞、不补测试、不处理跨 crate 重构。
limit_en: Only for Rust in the RTK repo; simplifies without behavior change. No security checks, no test writing, no cross-crate refactors. External repos.
title_en: Rust code reviewer that cuts over-engineering
